text.tspan: The program, the diet, and your sleep are 90% of the result — and they're drawn bigger here
than every compound combined. Tier 1 is an open shelf almost anyone serious can use. Tier 2
sits behind a lock you don't open without bloodwork, a doctor, and a plan — and even then
it's shown for transparency, not endorsement.

text.tspan: Compounds make the difference at the margins. The fundamentals are 90% of the actual outcome. The people who
make the most progress aren't the ones with the most exotic protocols — they're the ones who nailed the daily
structure, ran a consistent program for years, and added pharmacology only after they'd outgrown what training
1 Creatine 5 g/day year-round. · 2 Citrulline 6–8 g pre. · 3 Alpha-GPC 600 mg + Huperzine (cycled) pre. · 4
TMG 2.5–3 g w/ a meal. · 5 Add cut-only tools (caffeine · yohimbine FASTED) only during a deficit. · 6 Don't
touch Tier 2 until the Work is mastered AND the three keys are turned.

svg.text: This closes the 4-part Aesthetic & Strength series — Goal → Day → Program → Margin.

text.tspan: Not medical advice. Tier 2 compounds are not approved as dietary supplements in most countries and carry real risk without
medical supervision. Shared for transparency, not as a recommendation.
Sources: Creatine — ISSN/Kreider et al. 2017 · Yohimbine — Ostojic 2006 · Betaine — Cholewa et al. 2014 · Citrulline —
Schwedhelm et al. 2008 · Retatrutide — Jastreboff et al., NEJM 2023.
